description: The first claim is a primary-care preventive visit (an annual wellness visit with a depression screening). The first line is a covered preventive service that must cost the patient nothing, yet it shows a 20% coinsurance; the note on the line still says the patient pays nothing.

sources.what: Medicare pays 100% for listed preventive services (annual wellness visit, vaccines)
Part B deductible does not apply to the annual wellness visit or influenza vaccine
